meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: 它先把目标登记下来,再把工作拆成一条条细步骤写进实时清单;每个成功标准都要有真实来源的证据(终端、浏览器、数据库等),并在 .omo/ulw-loop 下保存带检查点的运行状态,中断后可续跑。
howto.when: 当你说出 ulw-loop、ulw 等关键词,或要求带检查点的长时目标执行时接管;任务含代码改动、测试或 QA 时按完整流程走。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 给这个任务登记目标
say.note: 会按 define-goal 规则先建目标

say.text: 把这步进展记进 ulw-loop 的检查点
查一下 ulw-loop 当前的运行状态

howto.what_en: It registers the run's goal, breaks work into fine steps in a live checklist, requires observable evidence from a real surface for each criterion, and keeps checkpointed state under .omo/ulw-loop so an interrupted run can resume.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask for ulw-loop, ulw, or checkpointed long-running goal execution; when the task includes code edits, tests, or QA it follows the full workflow.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to register a goal for this task
Record this step's progress in the ulw-loop checkpoint
Show the current ulw-loop run status
